55:* **Author eval suites** — create a runnable suite (name, default model, servers, test cases) synchronously and get a `suiteId`
back; no run is started and no credits are spent

295:| `GET`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE .../accounts[/{account}]` | The server's accounts. See [Server accounts](#server-accounts) |
296:| `POST .../oauth/import-tokens` | **Deprecated.** Uploads to your default account; use `PUT .../accounts/{account}`. See [The
deprecated import route](#the-deprecated-import-route) |
312:| `GET .../eval-runs/{runId}/iterations` | Per-iteration results: tool calls, token usage, latency (paginated) |
332:| `POST .../agent` | Run ONE assistant turn over a `messages` history (`{role: "user"\|"assistant", content}` items, max 50 me
ssages × 8 KB each, 96 KB total). The model is pinned server-side and billed to the project. The turn can read project servers/sui
tes/runs and **create eval suites**; it can NOT start runs — kick those off yourself with `POST .../eval-runs`. Responds synchrono
usly with `reply`, the `toolCalls` it made, `createdResources` (ids + app links), and token `usage`. Capped at 4 concurrent turns
per organization and \~90 s wall clock. **Not idempotent — never blind-retry**: dedupe on your own trigger identity, and on an err
or response check `details.createdResources` (and, after a lost response, list suites) before retrying, or you'll create duplicate
s |

403:> on every one: buying credits does not lift them, so do not retry in a loop
412:| `POST .../goals/{goalId}/runs` | **Launch.** Answers `202` — the fan-out has started, not finished. Send `Idempotency-Key`.
Optional `expectedSponsored` is how many conversations you expect MCPJam to sponsor; a different actual split is a `409` (`details
.code: swarm_funding_changed`) and nothing is created. The response can report `funding` (`sponsored`, `credits`, `total`) |

608:| `GET .../accounts/{account}` | One account |
609:| `PUT .../accounts/{account}` | Upload a token. Creates the account (`201`) or replaces its token in place (`200`, same id) |
